composition.title: Imaging report (synthetic): X-ray of the left knee

items.label: X-ray of the left knee, two views

sections.title: Order
sections.narrative: Requested by the emergency department: an elderly man fell on ice, with pain, swelling and inability to extend the left knee. Question: fracture?

sections.title: History
sections.narrative: On an oral anticoagulant, insulin-treated diabetes and hypertension; left-sided weakness after an earlier stroke. No earlier knee surgery. Known from the patient's Swedish patient summary.

sections.title: Procedure
sections.narrative: Anteroposterior and lateral projections of the left knee, taken supine in the emergency department. No contrast medium. Image quality adequate.

items.label: Closed fracture of patella
items.detail: Transverse fracture through the middle third of the left patella, with the fragments 8 mm apart and a step in the joint surface.; 2026-11-15T14:35:00+00:00

items.label: Knee joint effusion
items.detail: Moderate joint effusion with a fat-fluid level, consistent with bleeding into the joint. No fracture of the femur, tibia or fibula. Mild degenerative changes.; 2026-11-15T14:35:00+00:00

sections.title: Impression
sections.narrative: Displaced transverse fracture of the left patella with bleeding into the joint. Orthopaedic assessment for surgical fixation is recommended. Synthetic report for an invented person.

source.organization: Department of Radiology, Landspitali University Hospital, Reykjavik (simulated for the P24-Hackathon demo)
